answer_1.quote: We perform experiments on five different datasets. Each dataset corresponds to a different natural language generation task, including structured data text generation (e2e), code generation (CodeAlpaca-20k), mathematical reasoning (GSM8k), and dialogue summary generation (Dialogsum).
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language text (e.g., summaries, code snippets, answers, dialogues)

answer_2.quote: We adopt two widely used metrics for assessing natural language generation quality: RougeL-F and Meteor. ... We measure their effectiveness using text similarity scores RougeL-F and Meteor, with lower values indicating better defense performance.
